image_description: A domestic interior scene featuring a large, white, multi-section bookcase filled with books. Two black cats are sitting inside the lower open compartments of the bookcase. The background wall is covered in framed pictures and posters. A striped rug is visible on the floor in the foreground.

The right cat's paws blend into the cushion/shelf surface. The anatomy of the hind legs is indistinct, lacking clear separation between toes and the surface they rest on, suggesting slight melting or fusion.
The top horizontal line of the bookcase shows slight waviness and inconsistency in thickness, particularly near the center divider, indicating minor geometric instability.

To audit the boundary integrity of the cats, specifically checking for limb fusion with the bookcase shelves and cushion.
To verify the anatomical correctness of the two cats, ensuring they have the correct number of limbs and plausible sitting poses.

Anatomical integrity of the two black cats (paws, tails)
